visual_connections.description: User accesses the Orion URL which points to Route 53 for DNS resolution.
Route 53 directs traffic to the Application Load Balancer.
ALB forwards environment creation requests to application pods managed by EKS.
EKS schedules microservice provisioning jobs onto underlying EC2 Spot instances.
Jobs triggered in EKS send lifecycle events to SNS.
SNS fans out messages to SQS queue.
Replacement jobs running on Spot instances watch and consume state from SQS.
